clock.grid_alignment: event-regime start plus integer multiples of 30s
clock.flow_interval: strictly after t-30s and strictly before decision second t under second-granular fill timestamps
clock.same_second_rule: a fill timestamp equal to decision second is excluded from the t decision; it first becomes eligible at the next grid point
clock.quote_asof_rule: latest valid observable BBO with observed_at <= query time
clock.genuine_change: bid and/or ask changes from previous valid contiguous BBO; repeated identical rows are observation-only
clock.same_timestamp_conflict: fail timestamp closed and reset continuity
clock.future_markout_exposure_rule: future markout is available only when the target interval contains no invalid BBO barrier, event-level collector cadence has no gap above 30s, and a valid target observation confirms the state within 300s after the horizon; otherwise target is missing, never zero
clock.flow_interval_boundary_note: the human shorthand (t-30,t] is implemented fail-closed: fills timestamped exactly at t are excluded and first become eligible at the next 30s decision

discovery_split.purpose: model sanity and predictive increment inside 005A discovery; not pristine replication

a3_cross_market.aggregation: relationship_class then event/regime; never best edge
a3_cross_market.mandatory_interpretation: effect must add beyond A contemporaneous price move

a4_participant_role.historical_score_target: signed owner YES-pressure direction times subsequent own-market canonical YES move
a4_participant_role.challenger: generic signed taker flow plus signed taker flow × cross-fitted historical taker score
concentration_checks: top-1 top-5 top-10 volume wallet removal

a5_maker_liquidity.maker_markout: maker canonical YES-pressure sign × future canonical YES midpoint move
a5_maker_liquidity.capture_placebo: raw/repeated-identical record intensity and depth snapshot cadence

models.family: weighted ridge linear for continuous targets; ridge alpha fixed 1.0
models.minimum_effect_primary: positive out-of-sample loss improvement; effect magnitude reported, no discovered threshold

weighting.hierarchy: equal election family -> event -> 300s block -> market/pair -> row

sign_permutation.condition: only where mechanical token-side constraints permit

implementation_clarifications.reason: enforce preregistered supported-horizon/capture-cadence fail-closed policy; not informed by response outcomes
